reuse.why: Builds on the existing withBankAccountLinkGuard wrapper that all six providers already go through, and extracts the field clearing from unlinkAccount into clearAccountBankLink that both paths now share.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the unlinked-account field list now has a single definition used by unlinkAccount and the takeover.

placement.why: The takeover lives in the shared link guard, after the provider handler succeeds, so closed-account refusal and other rules still run first without per-provider edits.

scope.why: Only the flag, the guard, the extracted helper and focused tests change.

maintainability.why: Small, clearly named helpers (findBankAccountLink, clearAccountBankLink) and a single wrapper make the rule easy to follow and evolve.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses withBankAccountLinkGuard and shares clearAccountBankLink with unlinkAccount
